mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls and decrease in unemployment rate indicates a robust labor market that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, a decline in industrial production signals ongoing supply chain disruptions that reduce manufacturing activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during post-pandemic recovery when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate indicates improving labor market conditions that support corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1500.0 thousand units, it indicates robust consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1500.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI and decrease in industrial production indicates stagflationary pressures that erode corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, a quarterly GDP growth rate below 2.0% signals an economic slowdown that triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
